IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_EntryTooltip: Hire nearby A-Life NPCs with community currency, or have A-Life send a fresh one. Hotkey: Ctrl+Alt+N.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_HireHint: Pick a nearby NPC on the left, then press Hire.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_RosterHint: Pick an employee on the left to change their post or dismiss them.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_SummonHint1: A-Life spawns a brand new friendly NPC next to you, yours from the first second.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_SummonHint2: More expensive, but always friendly. Where it appears is set by the SpawnDistance sandbox option.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_SummonHint3: If A-Life hit its population ceiling the spawn fails -- the fee is refunded in full.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_WageLine: Daily wage each: %1 (unpaid wages end the contract after the grace period)
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_WarnDisabled: This mod is disabled in the sandbox options.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_WarnNoEconomy: YeseMarket not found: no way to pay, hiring is unavailable.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_WarnNoAlife: Project A-Life not found (or not started yet): hiring is unavailable for now.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_WarnNoJeem: Jeem Extension not found: only Follow and Guard posts are available.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_DetailUnpaid: Warning: unpaid wage -- this employee walks away when the grace period ends.
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonDisabled: the mod is disabled in the sandbox options
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonTakenByO: this NPC is already employed by someone else
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonNotActiv: this NPC is not in the world yet
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonHostile: that NPC is hostile (allow it in the sandbox options)
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonSpawnFai: A-Life could not spawn the NPC (population ceiling?)
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonTooFast: too fast, try again in a moment
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonResident: resident conversion refused (%1), fell back to Follow
IGUI_Bin2NPCExtensionYese_ReasonGuardRef: guard post refused (%1), fell back to Follow
